results.method: LEAN_NUM_THREADS=4 lake build ReluLayer ReluLayer.PTX.Optional.AddressBounds ReluLayer.PTX.Optional.Separation; then LEAN_NUM_THREADS=1 lake env lean --run checks/{RowSelection,AddressCalculation,BaseLoading,BodyContract,DotLoop,ReluSuffix,BodyExecution,KernelExecution,FloatArithmetic,RealDecode,RoundingError,SequentialBridge}.lean; Stratic validate; inspect source, theorem axioms, exact README signature and unchanged PTX hash
results.environment: Linux x86_64; Lean 4.35.0-rc4; unchanged dependency pins and four scripted compatibility edits; per-thread abstract word-memory execution with required context and supplied partial pointer conversion
results.evidence: The main library and both optional modules build (3114 jobs). All twelve checkers exit 0 without new unused-simp warnings. Direct FloatLib reference equations, concrete full-width FP32 and artificial order-sensitive execution, all source/instruction comparisons, output/bias aliasing, supplied conversion success/exclusion and missing parameters pass. New checks cover prefix saturation beyond width and exclusion of Returns from active zero-fuel states. The stored-output Sequential theorem uses only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound; source has no sorry/admit/custom axioms. The reference arithmetic record and redundant concrete kernel wrappers are removed, while reference-operation equations remain. The PTX source hash remains 9f0fe32284dd65ad4462be4dfb9175ed43a22ac57fb14fb20823eb7a54469f9f. README quotes the exact public theorem. Stratic validates source/description links and impact/unmapped explanations are accounted for. Content trees are identical before and after checks. Context arithmetic is mandatory and pointer conversion is an explicit entry assumption; hardware/device/all-thread guarantees remain outside scope. Pre-existing package/import warnings remain.
